nl: Identify people close to creators of long comments tagged with a given tag, then count those who studied at a specified university in a specified city.
original:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cmt:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(fr:Person)
WHERE cmt.length > $minCommentLength
WITH fr, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (fr)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE u.name = $university AND ci.name = $city
RETURN ci.name AS city, u.name AS university, count(DISTINCT fr) AS personCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cmt:Comment2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person1)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(fr:Person1)
RETURN t.id as tid, cmt.id as cmtid, fr.id as frid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select neo4j.frid, count(DISTINCT neo4j.cmtid) AS c
from neo4j,Comment Comment0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Comment0.length > $minCommentLength and neo4j.cmtid = Comment0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j.frid
) b1
where c > 3
stages.core_sql:
select neo4j.frid, count(DISTINCT neo4j.cmtid) AS c
from neo4j,Comment Comment0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Comment0.length > $minCommentLength and neo4j.cmtid = Comment0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j.frid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (fr:Person1)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
RETURN u.id as uid, ci.id as ciid, fr.id as frid
stages.sql:
select University0.name AS university, count(DISTINCT neo4j.frid) AS personCount, City0.name AS city
from neo4j,University University0, City City0, seg1
where City0.name = $city and University0.name = $university and neo4j.uid = University0.id and neo4j.ciid = City0.id and neo4j.frid = seg1.frid
group by University0.name AS university, City0.name AS city
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (fr:Person1 {id: b.frid})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
RETURN u.id as uid, ci.id as ciid, fr.id as frid
stages.core_sql:
select University0.name AS university, count(DISTINCT neo4j.frid) AS personCount, City0.name AS city
from neo4j,University University0, City City0, seg1
where City0.name = $city and University0.name = $university and neo4j.uid = University0.id and neo4j.ciid = City0.id and neo4j.frid = seg1.frid
group by University0.name AS university, City0.name AS city

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select * from (
select neo4j1.frid, count(DISTINCT neo4j1.cmtid) AS c
from neo4j1,Comment Comment0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Comment0.length > $minCommentLength and neo4j1.cmtid = Comment0.id and neo4j1.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j1.frid
) b1
where c > 3
)
select University0.name AS university, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.frid) AS personCount, City0.name AS city
from neo4j2,University University0, City City0, seg1
where City0.name = $city and University0.name = $university and neo4j2.uid = University0.id and neo4j2.ciid = City0.id and neo4j2.frid = seg1.frid
group by University0.name AS university, City0.name AS city

nl: Find people near members of recent forums tagged with a given tag, then count those working at a specified company in a specified country.
original:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(r:Person)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumSince
WITH r, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (r)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE co.name = $company AND country.name = $country
RETURN country.name AS country, co.name AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS workerCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum2)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person1)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(r:Person1)
RETURN t.id as tid, r.id as rid, fo.id as foid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select neo4j.rid, count(DISTINCT neo4j.foid) AS c
from neo4j,Forum Forum0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Forum0.creationDate > $forumSince and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j.rid
) b1
where c > 2
stages.core_sql:
select neo4j.rid, count(DISTINCT neo4j.foid) AS c
from neo4j,Forum Forum0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Forum0.creationDate > $forumSince and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j.rid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (r:Person1)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
RETURN country.id as countryid, co.id as coid, r.id as rid
stages.sql:
select Company0.name AS company, Country0.name AS country, count(DISTINCT neo4j.rid) AS workerCount
from neo4j,Company Company0, Country Country0, seg1
where Country0.name = $country and Company0.name = $company and neo4j.coid = Company0.id and neo4j.countryid = Country0.id and neo4j.rid = seg1.rid
group by Company0.name AS company, Country0.name AS country
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (r:Person1 {id: b.rid})-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
RETURN country.id as countryid, co.id as coid, r.id as rid
stages.core_sql:
select Company0.name AS company, Country0.name AS country, count(DISTINCT neo4j.rid) AS workerCount
from neo4j,Company Company0, Country Country0, seg1
where Country0.name = $country and Company0.name = $company and neo4j.coid = Company0.id and neo4j.countryid = Country0.id and neo4j.rid = seg1.rid
group by Company0.name AS company, Country0.name AS country

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select * from (
select neo4j1.rid, count(DISTINCT neo4j1.foid) AS c
from neo4j1,Forum Forum0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Forum0.creationDate > $forumSince and neo4j1.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j1.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j1.rid
) b1
where c > 2
)
select Company0.name AS company, Country0.name AS country, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.rid) AS workerCount
from neo4j2,Company Company0, Country Country0, seg1
where Country0.name = $country and Company0.name = $company and neo4j2.coid = Company0.id and neo4j2.countryid = Country0.id and neo4j2.rid = seg1.rid
group by Company0.name AS company, Country0.name AS country

nl: Select people close to creators of sufficiently long tagged messages, then count posts in a particular forum they moderate by post browser.
original:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE m.length > $minMessageLength
WITH q, count(DISTINCT m) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (q)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)
WHERE fo.title = $forumTitle AND po.creationDate > $postSince
RETURN fo.title AS forumTitle, po.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person1)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person1)
RETURN t.id as tid, m.id as mid, q.id as qid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select count(DISTINCT neo4j.mid) AS c, neo4j.qid
from neo4j,Message Message0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Message0.length > $minMessageLength and neo4j.mid = Message0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j.qid
) b1
where c > 10
stages.core_sql:
select count(DISTINCT neo4j.mid) AS c, neo4j.qid
from neo4j,Message Message0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Message0.length > $minMessageLength and neo4j.mid = Message0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j.qid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (q:Person1)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum2)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post2)
RETURN fo.id as foid, po.id as poid, q.id as qid
stages.sql:
select Forum0.title AS forumTitle, Post0.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT neo4j.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j,Post Post0, Forum Forum0, seg1
where Forum0.title = $forumTitle and Post0.creationDate > $postSince and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j.qid = seg1.qid
group by Forum0.title AS forumTitle, Post0.browserUsed AS browser
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (q:Person1 {id: b.qid})<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum2)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post2)
RETURN fo.id as foid, po.id as poid, q.id as qid
stages.core_sql:
select Forum0.title AS forumTitle, Post0.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT neo4j.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j,Post Post0, Forum Forum0, seg1
where Forum0.title = $forumTitle and Post0.creationDate > $postSince and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j.qid = seg1.qid
group by Forum0.title AS forumTitle, Post0.browserUsed AS browser

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(DISTINCT neo4j1.mid) AS c, neo4j1.qid
from neo4j1,Message Message0, Tag Tag0
where Tag0.name = $tag and Message0.length > $minMessageLength and neo4j1.mid = Message0.id and neo4j1.tid = Tag0.id
group by neo4j1.qid
) b1
where c > 10
)
select Forum0.title AS forumTitle, Post0.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j2,Post Post0, Forum Forum0, seg1
where Forum0.title = $forumTitle and Post0.creationDate > $postSince and neo4j2.poid = Post0.id and neo4j2.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j2.qid = seg1.qid
group by Forum0.title AS forumTitle, Post0.browserUsed AS browser

nl: Find people near gender-filtered users interested in enough tags of a tag class, then count their liked comment replies to long posts by browser and location IP.
original:
MATCH (t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass), (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClass AND p.gender = $gender
WITH q, count(DISTINCT t) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (q)-[:LIKES]->(cmt:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)
WHERE cmt.creationDate > $commentSince AND po.length > $minPostLength
RETURN po.browserUsed AS browser, q.locationIP AS locationIP, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS likedReplyCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass), (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person1)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person1)
RETURN t.id as tid, tc.id as tcid, p.id as pid, q.id as qid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select count(DISTINCT neo4j.tid) AS c, neo4j.qid
from neo4j,Person Person0, TagClass TagClass0
where Person0.gender = $gender and TagClass0.name = $tagClass and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.tcid = TagClass0.id
group by neo4j.qid
) b1
where c > 2
stages.core_sql:
select count(DISTINCT neo4j.tid) AS c, neo4j.qid
from neo4j,Person Person0, TagClass TagClass0
where Person0.gender = $gender and TagClass0.name = $tagClass and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.tcid = TagClass0.id
group by neo4j.qid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (q:Person1)-[:LIKES]->(cmt:Comment2)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post2)
RETURN cmt.id as cmtid, po.id as poid, q.id as qid
stages.sql:
select Post0.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT neo4j.cmtid) AS likedReplyCount, Person0.locationIP AS locationIP
from neo4j,Post Post0, Comment Comment0, Person Person0, seg1
where Post0.length > $minPostLength and Comment0.creationDate > $commentSince and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.cmtid = Comment0.id and neo4j.qid = Person0.id and neo4j.qid = seg1.qid
group by Post0.browserUsed AS browser, Person0.locationIP AS locationIP
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (q:Person1 {id: b.qid})-[:LIKES]->(cmt:Comment2)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post2)
RETURN cmt.id as cmtid, po.id as poid, q.id as qid
stages.core_sql:
select Post0.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT neo4j.cmtid) AS likedReplyCount, Person0.locationIP AS locationIP
from neo4j,Post Post0, Comment Comment0, Person Person0, seg1
where Post0.length > $minPostLength and Comment0.creationDate > $commentSince and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.cmtid = Comment0.id and neo4j.qid = Person0.id and neo4j.qid = seg1.qid
group by Post0.browserUsed AS browser, Person0.locationIP AS locationIP

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(DISTINCT neo4j1.tid) AS c, neo4j1.qid
from neo4j1,Person Person0, TagClass TagClass0
where Person0.gender = $gender and TagClass0.name = $tagClass and neo4j1.pid = Person0.id and neo4j1.tcid = TagClass0.id
group by neo4j1.qid
) b1
where c > 2
)
select Post0.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.cmtid) AS likedReplyCount, Person0.locationIP AS locationIP
from neo4j2,Post Post0, Comment Comment0, Person Person0, seg1
where Post0.length > $minPostLength and Comment0.creationDate > $commentSince and neo4j2.poid = Post0.id and neo4j2.cmtid = Comment0.id and neo4j2.qid = Person0.id and neo4j2.qid = seg1.qid
group by Post0.browserUsed AS browser, Person0.locationIP AS locationIP

nl: Find tag names used on recent posts by people born before a cutoff who studied at more than the threshold number of universities, ranked by the number of such alumni authors.
original:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.birthday < $birthday
WITH p, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND tc.name = $tagClassName
RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT p) AS alumnusCount
ORDER BY alumnusCount DESC
LIMIT 20

stages.cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person1)
RETURN p.id as pid, u.id as uid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select count(neo4j.uid) AS c, neo4j.pid
from neo4j,Person Person0
where Person0.birthday < $birthday and neo4j.pid = Person0.id
group by neo4j.pid
) b1
where c > 2
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.uid) AS c, neo4j.pid
from neo4j,Person Person0
where Person0.birthday < $birthday and neo4j.pid = Person0.id
group by neo4j.pid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person1)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post2)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
RETURN t.id as tid, tc.id as tcid, p.id as pid, po.id as poid
stages.sql:
select count(DISTINCT neo4j.pid) AS alumnusCount, Tag0.name AS tagName
from neo4j,Post Post0, TagClass TagClass0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.pid = seg1.pid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
ORDER BY alumnusCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (p:Person1 {id: b.pid})<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post2)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
RETURN t.id as tid, tc.id as tcid, p.id as pid, po.id as poid
stages.core_sql:
select count(DISTINCT neo4j.pid) AS alumnusCount, Tag0.name AS tagName
from neo4j,Post Post0, TagClass TagClass0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.pid = seg1.pid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(neo4j1.uid) AS c, neo4j1.pid
from neo4j1,Person Person0
where Person0.birthday < $birthday and neo4j1.pid = Person0.id
group by neo4j1.pid
) b1
where c > 2
)
select count(DISTINCT neo4j2.pid) AS alumnusCount, Tag0.name AS tagName
from neo4j2,Post Post0, TagClass TagClass0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and neo4j2.poid = Post0.id and neo4j2.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.pid = seg1.pid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
ORDER BY alumnusCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20
full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e0.person_id AS pid, e0.university_id AS uid
FROM organisation f0, filter_person1 f1, person_studyat_organisation e0
WHERE f0.type='University' and f0.id=e0.university_id and f1.id=e0.person_id
),
seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(neo4j1.uid) AS c, neo4j1.pid
from neo4j1, r_person person0
where Person0.birthday < $birthday and neo4j1.pid = Person0.id
group by neo4j1.pid
) b1
where c > 2
),
neo4j2 AS (
SELECT e1.tag_id AS tid, e2.tagclass_id AS tcid, e0.person_id AS pid, e0.message_id AS poid
FROM filter_person1 f0, filter_post2 f1, message f2, message_hascreator_person e0, message_hastag_tag e1, tag_hastype_tagclass e2
WHERE f2.type='Post' and e0.message_id=e1.message_id and e1.tag_id=e2.tag_id and f0.id=e0.person_id and f1.id=e0.message_id and f2.id=e0.message_id
)
select count(DISTINCT neo4j2.pid) AS alumnusCount, Tag0.name AS tagName
from neo4j2, r_post post0, r_tagclass tagclass0, r_tag tag0, seg1
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and neo4j2.poid = Post0.id and neo4j2.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.pid = seg1.pid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
ORDER BY alumnusCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20

nl: For places hosting more than the threshold number of non-excluded universities, find popular tags of recent forums joined by local people of a given gender.
original:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversityName
WITH pl, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE p.gender = $gender AND f.creationDate > $forumDate
RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC
LIMIT 20

stages.cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
RETURN u.id as uid, pl.id as plid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select count(neo4j.uid) AS c, neo4j.plid
from neo4j,University University0
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversityName and neo4j.uid = University0.id
group by neo4j.plid
) b1
where c > 5
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.uid) AS c, neo4j.plid
from neo4j,University University0
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversityName and neo4j.uid = University0.id
group by neo4j.plid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person1)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum2)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
RETURN t.id as tid, f.id as fid, p.id as pid, pl.id as plid
stages.sql:
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j.fid) AS forumCount
from neo4j,Person Person0, Tag Tag0, Forum Forum0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Forum0.creationDate > $forumDate and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.fid = Forum0.id and neo4j.plid = seg1.plid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
ORDER BY forumCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (pl:Place {id: b.plid})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person1)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum2)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
RETURN t.id as tid, f.id as fid, p.id as pid, pl.id as plid
stages.core_sql:
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j.fid) AS forumCount
from neo4j,Person Person0, Tag Tag0, Forum Forum0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Forum0.creationDate > $forumDate and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.fid = Forum0.id and neo4j.plid = seg1.plid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(neo4j1.uid) AS c, neo4j1.plid
from neo4j1,University University0
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversityName and neo4j1.uid = University0.id
group by neo4j1.plid
) b1
where c > 5
)
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.fid) AS forumCount
from neo4j2,Person Person0, Tag Tag0, Forum Forum0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Forum0.creationDate > $forumDate and neo4j2.pid = Person0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.fid = Forum0.id and neo4j2.plid = seg1.plid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
ORDER BY forumCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20
full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e0.org_id AS uid, e0.loc_id AS plid
FROM organisation f0, organisation_islocatedin_place e0
WHERE f0.type='University' and f0.id=e0.org_id
),
seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(neo4j1.uid) AS c, neo4j1.plid
from neo4j1, r_university university0
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversityName and neo4j1.uid = University0.id
group by neo4j1.plid
) b1
where c > 5
),
neo4j2 AS (
SELECT e2.tag_id AS tid, e1.forum_id AS fid, e0.person_id AS pid, e0.loc_id AS plid
FROM filter_person1 f0, person_islocatedin_place e0, filter_forum2 f1, forum_hasmember_person e1, forum_hastag_tag e2
WHERE e0.person_id=e1.person_id and e1.forum_id=e2.forum_id and f0.id=e0.person_id and f1.id=e1.forum_id
)
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.fid) AS forumCount
from neo4j2, r_person person0, r_tag tag0, r_forum forum0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Forum0.creationDate > $forumDate and neo4j2.pid = Person0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.fid = Forum0.id and neo4j2.plid = seg1.plid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
ORDER BY forumCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20

nl: For cities with more than the threshold number of universities, rank browsers used on liked messages by workers at local organisations.
original:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCityName
WITH ci, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (ci)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(o:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:LIKES]->(m:Message)
WHERE o.name <> $excludedOrganisationName AND m.length > $minLength
RETURN m.browserUsed AS messageBrowser, count(DISTINCT p) AS likerCount
ORDER BY likerCount DESC
LIMIT 20

stages.cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
RETURN u.id as uid, ci.id as ciid
stages.sql:
select * from (

nl: Find employees of a named company who have authored the most tagged posts, then inspect their long comments on tagged posts.
original:
MATCH (co:Company {name: $companyName})<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WITH p, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(parent:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(rt:Tag)

WITH neo4j1 AS (

nl: Rank people connected to long messages located in the same place as a named company, then list recent forums they belong to and the tags of posts in those forums.
original:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $companyName AND m.length > $minLength
WITH p, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(post:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate
RETURN p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, fo.title AS forumTitle, tag.name AS postTagName, post.creationDate AS postCreationDate

stages.cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person1)

group by neo4j.pid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 100
stages.core_sql:

stages.core_sql:

full_sql:

nl: Identify the most common interests among workers of a named company within a tag class, then show forums and moderators associated with those interests.
original:
MATCH (co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE co.name = $companyName AND tc.name = $tagClassName
WITH t, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE mod.gender = $gender
RETURN t.name AS tagName, fo.title AS forumTitle, mod.firstName AS moderatorFirstName, mod.lastName AS moderatorLastName, city.name AS moderatorCityName

stages.cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person1)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
RETURN t.id as tid, tc.id as tcid, co.id as coid, p.id as pid
stages.sql:
select count(neo4j.pid) AS c, neo4j.tid
from neo4j,TagClass TagClass0, Company Company0
where TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and Company0.name = $companyName and neo4j.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j.coid = Company0.id
group by neo4j.tid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 100
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.pid) AS c, neo4j.tid
from neo4j,TagClass TagClass0, Company Company0
where TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and Company0.name = $companyName and neo4j.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j.coid = Company0.id
group by neo4j.tid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum2)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person1)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
RETURN t.id as tid, city.id as cityid, fo.id as foid, mod.id as modid
stages.sql:
select Forum0.title AS forumTitle, City0.name AS moderatorCityName, Person0.firstName AS moderatorFirstName, Tag0.name AS tagName, Person0.lastName AS moderatorLastName
from neo4j,Person Person0, City City0, Forum Forum0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and neo4j.modid = Person0.id and neo4j.cityid = City0.id and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.tid = seg1.tid
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (t:Tag {id: b.tid})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum2)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person1)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
RETURN t.id as tid, city.id as cityid, fo.id as foid, mod.id as modid
stages.core_sql:
select Forum0.title AS forumTitle, City0.name AS moderatorCityName, Person0.firstName AS moderatorFirstName, Tag0.name AS tagName, Person0.lastName AS moderatorLastName
from neo4j,Person Person0, City City0, Forum Forum0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and neo4j.modid = Person0.id and neo4j.cityid = City0.id and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.tid = seg1.tid

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select count(neo4j1.pid) AS c, neo4j1.tid

where TagClass0.name = $tagClassName and Company0.name = $companyName and neo4j1.tcid = TagClass0.id and neo4j1.coid = Company0.id
group by neo4j1.tid

LIMIT 100
)
select Forum0.title AS forumTitle, City0.name AS moderatorCityName, Person0.firstName AS moderatorFirstName, Tag0.name AS tagName, Person0.lastName AS moderatorLastName
from neo4j2,Person Person0, City City0, Forum Forum0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and neo4j2.modid = Person0.id and neo4j2.cityid = City0.id and neo4j2.foid = Forum0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.tid = seg1.tid
full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e1.tag_id AS tid, e2.tagclass_id AS tcid, e0.company_id AS coid, e0.person_id AS pid
FROM organisation f0, filter_person1 f1, person_workat_organisation e0, person_hasinterest_tag e1, tag_hastype_tagclass e2
WHERE f0.type='Company' and e0.person_id=e1.person_id and e1.tag_id=e2.tag_id and f0.id=e0.company_id and f1.id=e0.person_id

nl: Rank countries by filtered city residents near companies, then explore recent posts liked by people in those top countries.
original:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompanyName AND p.gender = $gender
WITH country, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 56
MATCH (country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(home:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(person:Person)-[:LIKES]->(post:Post)
WHERE post.creationDate > $postDate
RETURN country.name AS countryName, home.name AS cityName, person.firstName AS personFirstName, person.lastName AS personLastName, post.content AS likedPostContent

stages.cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person1)
RETURN country.id as countryid, co.id as coid, p.id as pid
stages.sql:
select neo4j.countryid, count(neo4j.pid) AS c
from neo4j,Person Person0, Company Company0
where Person0.gender = $gender and Company0.name <> $excludedCompanyName and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.coid = Company0.id
group by neo4j.countryid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 56
stages.core_sql:
select neo4j.countryid, count(neo4j.pid) AS c
from neo4j,Person Person0, Company Company0
where Person0.gender = $gender and Company0.name <> $excludedCompanyName and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.coid = Company0.id

stages.sql:

where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and neo4j.countryid = Country0.id and neo4j.postid = Post0.id and neo4j.homeid = City0.id and neo4j.personid = Person0.id and neo4j.countryid = seg1.countryid
stages.bound_cypher:

stages.core_sql:

from neo4j,Country Country0, Post Post0, City City0, Person Person0, seg1

full_sql:

nl: Find forums with the most members employed by a named company, then list long replies and their authors inside those forums.
original:

WITH fo, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (fo)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(post:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)
WHERE cm.length > $commentLength
RETURN fo.title AS forumTitle, post.content AS postContent, cm.content AS commentContent, author.firstName AS authorFirstName, author.lastName AS authorLastName

stages.cypher:

stages.sql:
select neo4j.foid, count(neo4j.pid) AS c
from neo4j,Company Company0

nl: Find countries with the most cities other than a specified city, then analyze recent posts from those countries by creator gender and return the most common interest tags of their creators.
original: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City) WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity WITH co, count(ci) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 6 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND p.gender = $gender RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)
RETURN ci.id as ciid, co.id as coid
stages.sql:
select count(neo4j.ciid) AS c, neo4j.coid
from neo4j,City City0
where City0.name <> $excludedCity and neo4j.ciid = City0.id
group by neo4j.coid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 6
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.ciid) AS c, neo4j.coid
from neo4j,City City0
where City0.name <> $excludedCity and neo4j.ciid = City0.id
group by neo4j.coid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person1)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
RETURN t.id as tid, p.id as pid, po.id as poid, co.id as coid
stages.sql:
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j,Person Person0, Post Post0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Post0.creationDate > $postDate and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.coid = seg1.coid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (co:Country {id: b.coid})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person1)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
RETURN t.id as tid, p.id as pid, po.id as poid, co.id as coid
stages.core_sql:
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j,Person Person0, Post Post0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Post0.creationDate > $postDate and neo4j.pid = Person0.id and neo4j.poid = Post0.id and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.coid = seg1.coid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select count(neo4j1.ciid) AS c, neo4j1.coid
from neo4j1,City City0
where City0.name <> $excludedCity and neo4j1.ciid = City0.id
group by neo4j1.coid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 6
)
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j2,Person Person0, Post Post0, Tag Tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Post0.creationDate > $postDate and neo4j2.pid = Person0.id and neo4j2.poid = Post0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.coid = seg1.coid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName
full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e0.subreg_id AS ciid, e0.reg_id AS coid
FROM place f0, place f1, place_ispartof_place e0
WHERE f0.type='Country' and f1.type='City' and f0.id=e0.reg_id and f1.id=e0.subreg_id
),
seg1 AS (
select count(neo4j1.ciid) AS c, neo4j1.coid
from neo4j1, r_city city0
where City0.name <> $excludedCity and neo4j1.ciid = City0.id
group by neo4j1.coid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 6
),
neo4j2 AS (
SELECT e2.tag_id AS tid, e1.person_id AS pid, e0.message_id AS poid, e0.loc_id AS coid
FROM place f0, filter_post2 f1, message f2, message_islocatedin_place e0, filter_person1 f3, message_hascreator_person e1, person_hasinterest_tag e2
WHERE f0.type='Country' and f2.type='Post' and e0.message_id=e1.message_id and e1.person_id=e2.person_id and f0.id=e0.loc_id and f1.id=e0.message_id and f2.id=e0.message_id and f3.id=e1.person_id
)
select Tag0.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.poid) AS postCount
from neo4j2, r_person person0, r_post post0, r_tag tag0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Post0.creationDate > $postDate and neo4j2.pid = Person0.id and neo4j2.poid = Post0.id and neo4j2.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j2.coid = seg1.coid
group by Tag0.name AS tagName

nl: Rank countries by the number of companies excluding a named company, then inspect longer comments from those countries and group them by the commenters' employers and browsers.
original: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company) WHERE comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH co, count(comp) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 22 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(org:Organisation) WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength AND p.browserUsed = $browser RETURN org.name AS organisationName, p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT cm) AS commentCount

nl: Find people who created many recent posts in a country, then count the longer comments liked by their one- or two-hop acquaintances by the acquaintances' browser.
original:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)
WHERE f.gender = $gender AND cm.length > $commentLength
RETURN f.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT cm) AS likedCommentCount

stages.cypher:

RETURN co.id as coid, p.id as pid, po.id as poid

from neo4j,Country Country0, Post Post0
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Country0.name = $countryName and neo4j.coid = Country0.id and neo4j.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j.pid
) b1
where c > 5
stages.core_sql:
select neo4j.pid, count(neo4j.poid) AS c

where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Country0.name = $countryName and neo4j.coid = Country0.id and neo4j.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j.pid

stages.bound_cypher:

MATCH (p:Person1 {id: b.pid})-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person1)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment2)

stages.core_sql:

where Comment0.length > $commentLength and Person0.gender = $gender and neo4j.cmid = Comment0.id and neo4j.fid = Person0.id and neo4j.pid = seg1.pid
group by Person0.browserUsed AS browserUsed

where c > 5

WITH p, count(comp) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum)

stages.core_sql:

group by Forum0.title AS forumTitle
stages.bound_cypher:

nl: Find the top forum members from recent forums who are interested in a given tag, then summarize where those people studied within a target country.
original:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND t.name = $tagName
WITH p, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (p)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND u.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN u.name AS universityName, co.name AS countryName, count(p) AS personCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum2)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person1)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
RETURN t.id as tid, fo.id as foid, p.id as pid
stages.sql:
select count(neo4j.foid) AS c, neo4j.pid
from neo4j,Tag Tag0, Forum Forum0
where Tag0.name = $tagName and Forum0.creationDate > $forumDate and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id
group by neo4j.pid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 10000
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.foid) AS c, neo4j.pid
from neo4j,Tag Tag0, Forum Forum0
where Tag0.name = $tagName and Forum0.creationDate > $forumDate and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.foid = Forum0.id
group by neo4j.pid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person1)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
RETURN u.id as uid, co.id as coid, p.id as pid
stages.sql:
select count(neo4j.pid) AS personCount, Country0.name AS countryName, University0.name AS universityName
from neo4j,Country Country0, University University0, seg1
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversity and Country0.name = $countryName and neo4j.coid = Country0.id and neo4j.uid = University0.id and neo4j.pid = seg1.pid
group by Country0.name AS countryName, University0.name AS universityName
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (p:Person1 {id: b.pid})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
RETURN u.id as uid, co.id as coid, p.id as pid
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.pid) AS personCount, Country0.name AS countryName, University0.name AS universityName
from neo4j,Country Country0, University University0, seg1
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversity and Country0.name = $countryName and neo4j.coid = Country0.id and neo4j.uid = University0.id and neo4j.pid = seg1.pid
group by Country0.name AS countryName, University0.name AS universityName

combined_sql:

select count(neo4j1.foid) AS c, neo4j1.pid
from neo4j1,Tag Tag0, Forum Forum0

group by neo4j1.pid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 10000
)
select count(neo4j2.pid) AS personCount, Country0.name AS countryName, University0.name AS universityName
from neo4j2,Country Country0, University University0, seg1
where University0.name <> $excludedUniversity and Country0.name = $countryName and neo4j2.coid = Country0.id and neo4j2.uid = University0.id and neo4j2.pid = seg1.pid
group by Country0.name AS countryName, University0.name AS universityName
full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e1.tag_id AS tid, e0.forum_id AS foid, e0.person_id AS pid
FROM filter_forum2 f0, filter_person1 f1, forum_hasmember_person e0, person_hasinterest_tag e1
WHERE e0.person_id=e1.person_id and f0.id=e0.forum_id and f1.id=e0.person_id
),
seg1 AS (
select count(neo4j1.foid) AS c, neo4j1.pid

nl: Rank tags used in recent forum posts, then inspect the tag-class hierarchy above the top tags.
original:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND t.name <> $excludedTag
WITH t, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (t)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(super:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(root:TagClass)
WHERE super.name = $superClassName
RETURN super.name AS superClassName, root.name AS rootClassName, count(t) AS tagCount

stages.cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum2)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post2)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
RETURN t.id as tid, po.id as poid
stages.sql:
select neo4j.tid, count(neo4j.poid) AS c
from neo4j,Tag Tag0, Post Post0
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Tag0.name <> $excludedTag and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j.tid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 1000
stages.core_sql:
select neo4j.tid, count(neo4j.poid) AS c
from neo4j,Tag Tag0, Post Post0
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Tag0.name <> $excludedTag and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j.tid

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(super:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(root:TagClass)
RETURN t.id as tid, root.id as rootid, super.id as superid
stages.sql:
select count(neo4j.tid) AS tagCount, TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName
from neo4j,TagClass TagClass0, TagClass TagClass1, seg1
where TagClass1.name = $superClassName and neo4j.rootid = TagClass0.id and neo4j.superid = TagClass1.id and neo4j.tid = seg1.tid
group by TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName
stages.bound_cypher:
UNWIND $seg1 AS b
MATCH (t:Tag {id: b.tid})-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(super:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(root:TagClass)
RETURN t.id as tid, root.id as rootid, super.id as superid
stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.tid) AS tagCount, TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName
from neo4j,TagClass TagClass0, TagClass TagClass1, seg1
where TagClass1.name = $superClassName and neo4j.rootid = TagClass0.id and neo4j.superid = TagClass1.id and neo4j.tid = seg1.tid
group by TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName

combined_sql:
with seg1 AS (
select neo4j1.tid, count(neo4j1.poid) AS c
from neo4j1,Tag Tag0, Post Post0
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Tag0.name <> $excludedTag and neo4j1.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j1.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j1.tid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 1000
)
select count(neo4j2.tid) AS tagCount, TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName
from neo4j2,TagClass TagClass0, TagClass TagClass1, seg1
where TagClass1.name = $superClassName and neo4j2.rootid = TagClass0.id and neo4j2.superid = TagClass1.id and neo4j2.tid = seg1.tid
group by TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName
full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e1.tag_id AS tid, e0.post_id AS poid
FROM filter_forum2 f0, filter_post2 f1, message f2, forum_containerof_message e0, message_hastag_tag e1
WHERE f2.type='Post' and e0.post_id=e1.message_id and f0.id=e0.forum_id and f1.id=e0.post_id and f2.id=e0.post_id
),
seg1 AS (
select neo4j1.tid, count(neo4j1.poid) AS c
from neo4j1, r_tag tag0, r_post post0
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Tag0.name <> $excludedTag and neo4j1.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j1.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j1.tid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 1000
),
neo4j2 AS (
SELECT e0.tag_id AS tid, e2.tag_id AS rootid, e1.tag_id AS superid
FROM tag_hastype_tagclass e0, tagclass_issubclassof_tagclass e1, tagclass_issubclassof_tagclass e2
WHERE e0.tagclass_id=e1.subtag_id and e1.tag_id=e2.subtag_id
)
select count(neo4j2.tid) AS tagCount, TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName
from neo4j2, r_tagclass tagclass0, r_tagclass tagclass1, seg1
where TagClass1.name = $superClassName and neo4j2.rootid = TagClass0.id and neo4j2.superid = TagClass1.id and neo4j2.tid = seg1.tid
group by TagClass1.name AS superClassName, TagClass0.name AS rootClassName

nl: Select cities whose residents moderate many forums, then count employees using a chosen browser at organizations in the same countries.
original:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE mod.gender = $moderatorGender
WITH city, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (city)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(employee:Person)
WHERE employee.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN org.name AS organisationName, employee.gender AS employeeGender, count(employee) AS employeeCount

stages.sql:

from neo4j,Person Person0
where Person0.gender = $moderatorGender and neo4j.modid = Person0.id
group by neo4j.cityid
ORDER BY c DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 100
stages.core_sql:

where Person0.gender = $moderatorGender and neo4j.modid = Person0.id

stages.bound_cypher:

stages.core_sql:
select count(neo4j.employeeid) AS employeeCount, Person0.gender AS employeeGender, Organisation0.name AS organisationName

select count(neo4j2.employeeid) AS employeeCount, Person0.gender AS employeeGender, Organisation0.name AS organisationName

full_sql:
WITH neo4j1 AS (
SELECT e0.forum_id AS foid, e1.loc_id AS cityid, e0.person_id AS modid
FROM filter_forum2 f0, filter_person1 f1, forum_hasmoderator_person e0, place f2, person_islocatedin_place e1

seg1 AS (

LIMIT 1000

WITH author, avg(po.length) AS avgPostLength
ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (author)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)

ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 100
stages.core_sql:

FROM filter_forum2 f0, forum_hastag_tag e0
WHERE f0.id=e0.forum_id
),
seg1 AS (
select * from (
select count(neo4j1.tid) AS c, neo4j1.fid
from neo4j1, r_tag tag0, r_forum forum0
where Forum0.creationDate > $forumCreatedAfter and Tag0.name <> $excludedTagName and neo4j1.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j1.fid = Forum0.id
group by neo4j1.fid
) b1
where c > 2
),
neo4j2 AS (
SELECT e1.message_id AS likedid, e0.person_id AS memberid, e0.forum_id AS fid
FROM filter_forum2 f0, filter_person1 f1, forum_hasmember_person e0, filter_post2 f2, message f3, person_likes_message e1
WHERE f3.type='Post' and e0.person_id=e1.person_id and f0.id=e0.forum_id and f1.id=e0.person_id and f2.id=e1.message_id and f3.id=e1.message_id
)
select Post0.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT neo4j2.memberid) AS memberCount
from neo4j2, r_post post0, r_person person0, seg1
where Person0.gender = $gender and Post0.creationDate > $postCreatedAfter and neo4j2.likedid = Post0.id and neo4j2.memberid = Person0.id and neo4j2.fid = seg1.fid
group by Post0.browserUsed AS browserUsed
ORDER BY memberCount DESC, 1, 2
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank creator browsers for long posts that are replied to by sufficiently long comments carrying many non-excluded tags.

stages.cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cm:Comment2)
RETURN t.id as tid, cm.id as cmid
stages.sql:
select * from (
select neo4j.cmid, count(neo4j.tid) AS c
from neo4j,Tag Tag0, Comment Comment0
where Comment0.length > $minCommentLength and Tag0.name <> $excludedTagName and neo4j.tid = Tag0.id and neo4j.cmid = Comment0.id
group by neo4j.cmid
) b1
where c > 2
stages.core_sql:

stages.cypher:
MATCH (cm:Comment2)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person1)

stages.sql:

stages.bound_cypher:

MATCH (cm:Comment2 {id: b.cmid})-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post2)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person1)

stages.core_sql:

WHERE f1.type='Comment' and f3.type='Post' and e0.replied_message_id=e1.message_id and f0.id=e0.message_id and f1.id=e0.message_id and f2.id=e0.replied_message_id and f3.id=e0.replied_message_id and f4.id=e1.person_id

nl: Find authors with more than a threshold number of long recent posts, then return properties of their one- or two-hop outgoing KNOWS contacts of a given gender.
original:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE f.gender = $gender
RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, f.firstName AS friendFirstName, f.lastName AS friendLastName, f.browserUsed AS friendBrowserUsed

RETURN p.id as pid, po.id as poid

select neo4j.pid, count(neo4j.poid) AS c
from neo4j,Post Post0
where Post0.creationDate > $postDate and Post0.length > $minPostLength and neo4j.poid = Post0.id
group by neo4j.pid
) b1
where c > 10
stages.core_sql:
select neo4j.pid, count(neo4j.poid) AS c
from neo4j,Post Post0
